entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I expect the lower levels to be even[n]more so.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hehehe, cool! Breakin' into a vault's[n]a perfect act for the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Quietly workin' to get inside with quick-[n]movin' fingertips...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And in the end, they expertly crack it[n]wide open, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll soon find out if fingertips will be[n]enough.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What kind of vault is this?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You'll understand once you see it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, doesn't Miss President seem like[n]she's in too good a mood?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, no matter. The path is open now,[n]so we should press onward.
